description: This file implements environment variable management functions for different operating systems, including getting, setting, unsetting environment variables, and manipulating environment blocks.

classes.name: EnvironmentImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of the Environment interface, providing platform-specific methods for environment variable access.

methods.name: GetVar
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable, trying alternate case if not found initially.

methods.name: SetVar
methods.description: Sets the value of an environment variable.

methods.name: ParseEnvLine
methods.description: Parses a line of environment block into key-value pair.

methods.name: AlterEnvironment
methods.description: Modifies environment block with specified changes, platform-specific implementation.
